阅读片段：

The policy experiment reduced energy consumption in office buildings, but the strongest effect came not from new equipment, but from behavioral feedback dashboards shown weekly to employees.

任务：哪一项与原文一致？

back_content.text: 答案：B。Behavioral feedback dashboards produced the strongest effect.
back_content.explanation: not from new equipment, but from ... dashboards把最强效果归给反馈面板，所以B正确。A选了被排除对象，C反转能耗下降，D把weekly改成仅最后一次。

analysis_content.text: not from new equipment, but from ... dashboards把最强效果归给反馈面板，所以B正确。A选了被排除对象，C反转能耗下降，D把weekly改成仅最后一次。
tips: 读not A but B时，记清作者把主要作用给了谁。

Behavioral feedback dashboards produced the strongest effect.
Feedback dashboards raised energy consumption in the buildings.

Weekly feedback helped employees reduce energy consumption in the office.

任务：判断：Reduced energy consumption was the reason employees received weekly feedback.

back_content.text: False。原文说反馈帮助降低能耗，不是能耗降低导致得到反馈。
back_content.explanation: 原句feedback是帮助实现变化的安排，reduce energy consumption是结果。判断句把结果放到reason位置，调换两者关系，即使关键词相同也不符合原文。

tips: 先写明“什么帮助实现什么”，再核对选项有没有把原因和结果对调。

front_content.text:
练习材料（虚构情境）
阅读片段：

The clinical trial found a modest improvement in memory retention, but no significant change in processing speed. Researchers cautioned that sample size limitations may have masked subgroup differences.

任务：哪项表述准确？

back_content.text: 答案：A。Memory improved slightly while processing speed showed no significant change.
back_content.explanation: modest improvement in memory retention是记忆小幅改善，no significant change in processing speed是速度未见显著变化，A准确。B把两者都说成显著提高，C否认样本限制，D把clinical trial换成非临床调查。

analysis_content.text: modest improvement in memory retention是记忆小幅改善，no significant change in processing speed是速度未见显著变化，A准确。B把两者都说成显著提高，C否认样本限制，D把clinical trial换成非临床调查。
tips: 同句列多个指标时，一个个配上改善程度，别把某项变化复制给另一项。

options.text: Memory improved slightly while processing speed showed no significant change.
Both memory and processing speed improved significantly.
The sample size was fully adequate for subgroup analysis.
The finding was based on a non-clinical field survey.

阅读片段：Economists expected wage subsidies to lift hiring, but the strongest response came from liquidity buffers that let small firms wait out demand shocks. Employers used the buffer not to expand immediately, but to avoid layoffs.

任务：原文中哪个名词短语直接说明避免裁员所依靠的安排？

back_content.explanation: liquidity buffers让小公司wait out demand shocks，并被用来avoid layoffs，因此C直接回答。wage subsidies是最初预期的工具，demand shocks是面临的冲击，small firms是受影响企业。

tips: 原因题不只找名词，还要读它后面let ...和used ... to说明的具体作用。

练习材料（虚构情境）
阅读片段：The reform created additional reporting layers. Nurses entered the same information into separate systems, and supervisors spent more time reconciling records than solving practical bottlenecks.

任务：划去与名词之间实际关系不符的判断。

back_content.text: 应划去：Nurses needed to enter each item only once in one shared system.；Supervisors spent more time solving bottlenecks than reconciling records.。
back_content.explanation: separate systems 与重复录入联系，reconciling records 与增加的工作时间联系。两个错误项分别把系统关系和 more...than... 的比较方向反过来了。

analysis_content.text: separate systems 与重复录入联系，reconciling records 与增加的工作时间联系。两个错误项分别把系统关系和 more...than... 的比较方向反过来了。
tips: 把 separate systems 与重复录入连起来，再核对 more...than... 的比较方向。

back_content.explanation: 作者把抵消节能收益的现象称为the rebound effect，故B正确。居民因取暖更便宜而提高室温是它的具体表现；insulation是原节能措施，expected savings是被抵消的收益。

analysis_content.text: 作者把抵消节能收益的现象称为the rebound effect，故B正确。居民因取暖更便宜而提高室温是它的具体表现；insulation是原节能措施，expected savings是被抵消的收益。
tips: 题目问现象的名称，就选作者给的名称；问表现时才答升高室温。

The devices were affordable, but adoption remained slow because installation required technicians who were in short supply. The authors called this a diffusion bottleneck.

任务：判断：The shortage of installers, rather than the price of the devices, was presented as the obstacle to wider adoption.

back_content.text: True。设备价格可负担，安装技术人员不足才是这里的推广障碍。
back_content.explanation: affordable排除价格过高这一解释，because之后说明technicians were in short supply。diffusion bottleneck在这里给这种推广阻碍命名，不是另一个无关问题。

analysis_content.text: affordable排除价格过高这一解释，because之后说明technicians were in short supply。diffusion bottleneck在这里给这种推广阻碍命名，不是另一个无关问题。
tips: 遇到专门名词，读它前后给的具体行为或条件，别只背抽象译名。

front_content.text:
练习材料（虚构情境）
阅读片段：The study argued that civic disengagement was driven less by apathy than by institutional opacity. Residents stopped attending meetings because decision procedures were hard to follow and outcomes seemed detached from local input.

任务：哪个名词短语是作者给出的主要解释？

back_content.explanation: less by apathy than by institutional opacity更强调制度不透明，故D正确。后句decision procedures were hard to follow具体解释不透明怎样让居民停止参加会议；disengagement是结果，apathy是被弱化的原因。

analysis_content.text: less by apathy than by institutional opacity更强调制度不透明，故D正确。后句decision procedures were hard to follow具体解释不透明怎样让居民停止参加会议；disengagement是结果，apathy是被弱化的原因。
tips: 把抽象opacity与后面的具体表现相连：程序难懂、意见与结果脱节。
